summary: Pitanium Limited, a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, disclosed in a Form 6-K that Nasdaq notified it on July 7, 2026 of a delisting determination for its Class A ordinary shares. Nasdaq filed a Form 25 on October 1, 2026, making the delisting effective October 11, 2026, with Section 12(b) deregistration effective roughly 90 days later. The board approved filing a Form 15 on September 28, 2026 to terminate Section 12(g) registration and suspend Section 15(d) reporting. Watch for OTC liquidity and reduced disclosure risk.
